items.text: Rotate and flip now share a slot in the pie menu; E/Q toggles between them while preserving muscle memory and adjusting building tiers accordingly.
Stair blocks and colliders updated for the Scrap King DLC, improving geometry, collision handling, and block behavior.
Softcore mode now disables the deployable corpse system and raises the maximum team count from 3 to 6; the main menu changelog reflects the new limit.
Introduced a Croc Pie recipe that uses the new animal repellent modifier, with accompanying UI updates and a richer version.
Fixed a server collider bug so sails no longer have both lowered and raised colliders active after spawning, preventing unexpected collisions.
Resolved an issue where lamps on player boats disappeared after moving away from the activation point due to dynamic marking problems.
Quit button functionality restored.
Reworded and inverted the inventory/crafting D‑Pad configuration description to reduce confusion.
Fixed a stray cart button appearing in the skin viewer when opened from the Steam inventory.
Spray can no longer becomes unusable after quickly looking away; re‑equip is no longer required and the extra third‑person animation was removed.
Fixed a bug that allowed non‑admin players to be killed in Halloween dungeons.

2026-10-22.summary:
### Building & Construction
- Rotate and flip now share a slot in the pie menu; E/Q toggles between them while preserving muscle memory and adjusting building tiers accordingly.
- Stair blocks and colliders updated for the Scrap King DLC, improving geometry, collision handling, and block behavior.

### Gameplay Modes & New Content
- Softcore mode now disables the deployable corpse system and raises the maximum team count from 3 to 6; the main menu changelog reflects the new limit.
- Introduced a Croc Pie recipe that uses the new animal repellent modifier, with accompanying UI updates and a richer version.

### Boat & Sailing Improvements
- Fixed a server collider bug so sails no longer have both lowered and raised colliders active after spawning, preventing unexpected collisions.
- Resolved an issue where lamps on player boats disappeared after moving away from the activation point due to dynamic marking problems.

### UI & Inventory Enhancements
- Quit button functionality restored.
- Reworded and inverted the inventory/crafting D‑Pad configuration description to reduce confusion.
- Fixed a stray cart button appearing in the skin viewer when opened from the Steam inventory.

### Gameplay Bug Fixes
- Spray can no longer becomes unusable after quickly looking away; re‑equip is no longer required and the extra third‑person animation was removed.
- Fixed a bug that allowed non‑admin players to be killed in Halloween dungeons.

items.text: Fixed several item and container bugs that caused rare errors when moving items from or destroying chicken coops, ensuring proper entity removal and preventing crashes.
Fixed all four skull trophy variants to have distinct visuals and correct state updates, and updated their colliders and glass physics material for the jar variants.
Corrected oak trees to drop apples only where appropriate, adjusted apple positions on oak varieties, and removed unnecessary loot refreshes on natural beehives, apple trees, and coconut trees.
Fixed triangle foundations being deployable on top of brutalist ramps and resolved square roof side overhangs blocking adjacent foundations.
Fixed ramps being incorrectly blocked by another ramp up to 3 m above them, even through a floor.
Unified colliders for floor frame and triangle floor frame skins of the same grade and standardized mesh colliders for stone frames and triangle roofs, eliminating placement blocking issues.
Adjusted graveyard fence collider import settings to match expected collision behavior.
Prevented the carvable pumpkin from being codelocked, closing an exploit that let players lock pumpkins they shouldn't be able to.
UZI weapon aim offset corrected, restoring proper aiming and shooting accuracy.
Added reactive bird flocks that move in swarms, avoid obstacles and players, and use boid movement with dynamic flapping, affecting hunting and wildlife encounters.

2026-10-21.summary:
### Inventory & Item Bugs
- Fixed several item and container bugs that caused rare errors when moving items from or destroying chicken coops, ensuring proper entity removal and preventing crashes.
- Fixed all four skull trophy variants to have distinct visuals and correct state updates, and updated their colliders and glass physics material for the jar variants.

### Resource Gathering
- Corrected oak trees to drop apples only where appropriate, adjusted apple positions on oak varieties, and removed unnecessary loot refreshes on natural beehives, apple trees, and coconut trees.

### Building & Structure Placement
- Fixed triangle foundations being deployable on top of brutalist ramps and resolved square roof side overhangs blocking adjacent foundations.
- Fixed ramps being incorrectly blocked by another ramp up to 3 m above them, even through a floor.
- Unified colliders for floor frame and triangle floor frame skins of the same grade and standardized mesh colliders for stone frames and triangle roofs, eliminating placement blocking issues.
- Adjusted graveyard fence collider import settings to match expected collision behavior.

### Security & Locks
- Prevented the carvable pumpkin from being codelocked, closing an exploit that let players lock pumpkins they shouldn't be able to.

### Combat & Weapons
- UZI weapon aim offset corrected, restoring proper aiming and shooting accuracy.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Added reactive bird flocks that move in swarms, avoid obstacles and players, and use boid movement with dynamic flapping, affecting hunting and wildlife encounters.

items.text: Young livestock now appear at the end of vendor lists, preventing them from hiding sellable animals, and a new dialogue stage provides extra information when bringing a young animal to the vendor.
Rentable shops no longer drop sulfur incorrectly during transactions.

Scrap requirements have been replaced with blueprint fragments for workbench crafting, introducing Fragment, Page, and Book tiers with new drop locations and upgrade paths, shifting tech‑tree progression to blueprint collection.
Low ramps can now be placed or upgraded without being blocked by deployables below, and roof‑overhang colliders have been fixed to allow block placement on building skins.
Players can remount vehicles after switching, with faster dismount rotation, and horses retain towed entities across server restarts.
Siege weapons no longer keep a pulling flag after a restart, and catapult reload progress bars disappear correctly when the catapult is destroyed.
Monument spawn bounds have been increased to prevent overlapping, terrain at key exit areas has been repainted to stop clipping, and underwater labs now generate correctly.
Additional line‑of‑sight check points for various stair shapes improve combat visibility, and gun accessories can now be changed on the repair bench even when the weapon has no skin applied.
Tutorial can now be run locally with under 10 GB memory usage and asset bundle build time cut in half
Mortar now plays its firing animation instead of snapping after a shot
Vine mountables no longer error after a server restart and reset correctly
Boat wiring no longer breaks when leaving edit mode
Wires parented to doors stop stretching to the world origin after network range changes
Train track splines retain descendants, fixing tunnel lights for players using trains
Poolable components added to many wearables reduce creation cost from >1 ms to <0.1 ms, smoothing performance when changing clothes or entering range
Main‑menu chat no longer hides the screen when RRP is enabled
Safe‑zone warning popup no longer persists on the main menu and now shows its title
Country selection UI fixed, preventing empty lists and related UI init issues
Boosts UI no longer shows a movement‑speed modifier when leading animals or pulling siege weapons
Console autocompletion now respects case, fixing lowercase entity name/path issues
Tutorial videos converted to WebM and the welcome video now plays correctly
Foliage grid null‑reference crash prevented when heightmap is missing
Base rooms now only regenerate the parts that were changed, preventing full rebuilds and potential loss of items when editing structures.
Mortar reload now plays the correct sound, giving clear audio feedback when reloading the weapon.
Boat scientist AI now correctly respects the Convar.AI.ignoreplayers setting, allowing players to be ignored by these NPCs when configured.

2026-10-20.summary:
### Trading & Economy
- Young livestock now appear at the end of vendor lists, preventing them from hiding sellable animals, and a new dialogue stage provides extra information when bringing a young animal to the vendor.
- Rentable shops no longer drop sulfur incorrectly during transactions.

### Crafting Overhaul
- Scrap requirements have been replaced with blueprint fragments for workbench crafting, introducing Fragment, Page, and Book tiers with new drop locations and upgrade paths, shifting tech‑tree progression to blueprint collection.

### Building Placement
- Low ramps can now be placed or upgraded without being blocked by deployables below, and roof‑overhang colliders have been fixed to allow block placement on building skins.

### Vehicles & Siege Weapons
- Players can remount vehicles after switching, with faster dismount rotation, and horses retain towed entities across server restarts.
- Siege weapons no longer keep a pulling flag after a restart, and catapult reload progress bars disappear correctly when the catapult is destroyed.

### World Generation
- Monument spawn bounds have been increased to prevent overlapping, terrain at key exit areas has been repainted to stop clipping, and underwater labs now generate correctly.

### Combat & Weapon Customization
- Additional line‑of‑sight check points for various stair shapes improve combat visibility, and gun accessories can now be changed on the repair bench even when the weapon has no skin applied.

### Gameplay & Mechanics
- Tutorial can now be run locally with under 10 GB memory usage and asset bundle build time cut in half
- Mortar now plays its firing animation instead of snapping after a shot
- Vine mountables no longer error after a server restart and reset correctly
- Boat wiring no longer breaks when leaving edit mode
- Wires parented to doors stop stretching to the world origin after network range changes
- Train track splines retain descendants, fixing tunnel lights for players using trains

### Performance
- Poolable components added to many wearables reduce creation cost from >1 ms to <0.1 ms, smoothing performance when changing clothes or entering range

### UI & Quality of Life
- Main‑menu chat no longer hides the screen when RRP is enabled
- Safe‑zone warning popup no longer persists on the main menu and now shows its title
- Country selection UI fixed, preventing empty lists and related UI init issues
- Boosts UI no longer shows a movement‑speed modifier when leading animals or pulling siege weapons
- Console autocompletion now respects case, fixing lowercase entity name/path issues
- Tutorial videos converted to WebM and the welcome video now plays correctly

### Bug Fixes
- Foliage grid null‑reference crash prevented when heightmap is missing

### Gameplay & Balance
- Base rooms now only regenerate the parts that were changed, preventing full rebuilds and potential loss of items when editing structures.
- Mortar reload now plays the correct sound, giving clear audio feedback when reloading the weapon.
- Boat scientist AI now correctly respects the Convar.AI.ignoreplayers setting, allowing players to be ignored by these NPCs when configured.
